title: Spring Garden Wedding Showcase
location: Himaya Garden Main Lawn & Tea House
shortDescription: Experience the magic of a spring garden wedding at Himaya. Tour our venue styled for the season, meet our preferred vendors, and enjoy light refreshments.
description: Join us for an exclusive open house event where you can experience Himaya Garden transformed for a spring wedding celebration. Walk through our beautifully styled ceremony and reception spaces, meet our curated list of preferred vendors including florists, caterers, and photographers, and enjoy complimentary champagne and hors d'oeuvres. Our team will be available to answer questions, discuss availability, and help you envision your special day. This is the perfect opportunity to see our venue in full bloom and start planning your dream wedding.

title: Autumn Harvest Dinner Under the Stars
shortDescription: A farm-to-table dining experience celebrating the autumn harvest. Local chefs create a seasonal menu beneath our twinkling garden lights.
description: Savor the flavors of the season at our annual Autumn Harvest Dinner. Set beneath a canopy of twinkling lights on the Tea House Terrace, this intimate farm-to-table experience features a multi-course menu crafted by renowned local chefs using ingredients sourced from Southern Arizona farms. The evening begins with a welcome cocktail hour in the garden, followed by a seated dinner with wine pairings. Live acoustic music sets the mood as the sun sets over the desert landscape. A portion of proceeds benefits local agricultural education programs.

title: Morning Yoga in the Garden
shortDescription: Begin your Sunday with a peaceful yoga session surrounded by native desert flora and the gentle sounds of nature.
description: Start your Sunday with intention and tranquility in our Meditation Grove. This all-levels yoga session is led by certified instructor Maria Santos and is suitable for beginners and experienced practitioners alike. The class flows through gentle stretches, mindful breathing, and meditation surrounded by the serene beauty of our desert garden. After class, enjoy a complimentary herbal tea and light breakfast bites. Please bring your own mat and water bottle. In case of inclement weather, the session moves to the covered Tea House porch.

title: Desert Floral Arrangement Workshop
shortDescription: Learn to create stunning arrangements using native desert botanicals, succulents, and seasonal blooms with guidance from a local floral artist.
description: Discover the art of desert floral design in this hands-on workshop led by acclaimed Tucson floral artist Elena Vargas. You'll learn techniques for working with unique desert botanicals including cactus flowers, succulents, wild grasses, and seasonal blooms. Each participant will create a beautiful centerpiece arrangement to take home, along with a care guide for maintaining desert plants. All materials, tools, and a light afternoon tea are included. Perfect for aspiring florists, DIY brides, or anyone who loves working with nature's unique palette.

title: Holiday Garden Market
shortDescription: A curated outdoor market featuring local artisans, handmade gifts, seasonal treats, and live music in our festive garden setting.
description: Get into the holiday spirit at our annual Holiday Garden Market. Stroll through our festively decorated garden as you browse handcrafted goods from over 30 local artisans and makers. Find unique gifts including hand-poured candles, desert-inspired jewelry, botanical prints, artisanal foods, and more. Enjoy live acoustic music, warm spiced cider, and fresh-baked treats from local bakeries. Santa will be available for photos in the Tea House, and children can participate in a free ornament-making craft station. Free admission with a suggested donation of a non-perishable food item for the local food bank.

title: Full Moon Meditation & Sound Bath
shortDescription: A guided meditation and crystal bowl sound bath under the full moon. Connect with nature and find deep relaxation.
description: Experience profound relaxation and renewal under the glow of the full moon. This guided meditation session combines mindfulness practices with the healing vibrations of crystal singing bowls and chimes. Led by meditation guide and sound healer James Chen, the session is designed to help you release stress, set intentions for the lunar cycle ahead, and connect deeply with the natural world around you. Please bring a yoga mat, blanket, and any cushions for comfort. Warm herbal tea will be served afterward as we gather to share reflections under the stars.

title: Private Event Consultation Day
shortDescription: Schedule a one-on-one consultation with our event team to plan your wedding, celebration, or corporate gathering at Himaya Garden.
description: Thinking of hosting your special event at Himaya Garden? Our Private Event Consultation Day offers prospective clients the opportunity to meet one-on-one with our experienced event coordinators. Tour the venue, discuss your vision, review our packages and pricing, and get answers to all your questions. Whether you're planning an intimate elopement, a grand wedding, a milestone birthday, or a corporate retreat, we'll help you understand how Himaya Garden can bring your vision to life. Appointments are 45 minutes each and include a full venue tour and complimentary refreshments. Booking required.

title: Live Jazz at Sunset
shortDescription: An evening of smooth jazz, craft cocktails, and stunning desert sunset views. Featuring the Tucson Jazz Collective.
description: Unwind with an evening of world-class jazz as the sun sets over the Sonoran Desert. The Tucson Jazz Collective brings their signature blend of classic standards and contemporary fusion to our Main Lawn stage. Guests will enjoy reserved seating, a welcome cocktail, and access to a curated menu of small plates and desserts available for purchase. The garden bar will feature signature cocktails inspired by desert botanicals. Dress is garden casual to cocktail attire. This event tends to sell out quickly, so early booking is recommended.
